purpose: Screen the independent Dominguez-Garcia et al. 2026 eight-year, 12-site plant-pollinator dataset for a non-circular replication of the Villavicencio gain/loss opportunity-axis asymmetry.

source.article: Dominguez-Garcia et al. 2026 Ecology Letters e70293

admission_requirements: site x year or finer interaction data sufficient to reconstruct link gain and loss among shared species
plant-side opportunity information measured independently of the focal link outcome, such as flower abundance or activity
pollinator-side opportunity information measured independently of the focal link outcome, such as abundance or activity
species and site/year identifiers sufficient to keep repeated observations and independent sites distinct
exposure definitions must not be derived from the same focal gain/loss response
reject_or_downgrade_if: only aggregate turnover statistics are public
plant/pollinator opportunity fields are interaction-derived in a way that reuses the focal response
link-level temporal states cannot be reconstructed
candidate_replication: Test only the pre-frozen directional predictive-information asymmetry on the recorded annual-link surface under leave-one-site-out validation. Interpret any matching direction as observed-link predictive consistency, not detection-defensible latent-state replication. Do not test routeability.
claim_ceiling: Recorded-link predictive-direction test only. The dataset-specific response-validity gate classifies the public processed annual link surface as observed_link_turnover_only, so neither a matching nor mismatching axis direction establishes a latent ecological assembly/disassembly mechanism, decision equivalence, or routeability.

source_audit.plant_abundance_provenance: Annual plant resource abundance was measured from flower counts in ten 1 m2 subplots and normalized by annual sampling effort. Plant phenology was measured as the number of days the species was present in the field.
source_audit.pollinator_abundance_boundary: Published pollinator abundance counts recorded individuals and may share observation support with the interaction network, so raw Abundance is not the primary pollinator-side exposure for the focal-dyad replication.
source_audit.primary_pollinator_axis: current-year number of distinct other plant partners recorded for the focal pollinator after excluding the focal plant; the focal dyad can never contribute to this predictor
source_audit.source_article: Dominguez-Garcia et al. 2026 Ecology Letters e70293

replication_design.unit: shared-species plant-pollinator dyad within adjacent site-year transition

response.gain: dyad absent at t and present at t+1 among plant and pollinator species present in both years
response.loss: dyad present at t and absent at t+1 among plant and pollinator species present in both years

species_presence.purpose: define shared-species risk sets independently of focal dyad link state

predictors.plant_availability: current-year PhenologyP (plant activity/flowering duration) for the focal plant
predictors.pollinator_activity: current-year distinct other-plant partner count for the focal pollinator, excluding the focal plant

replication_design.cross_validation: leave-one-site-out; each of the 12 sites is held out in turn
replication_design.classification: report pooled contrast and the number of held-out sites with the frozen directional contrast; do not tune definitions after seeing the result

plant_abundance_sensitivity.replacement: replace PhenologyP with current-year AbundanceP while keeping focal-excluded pollinator activity unchanged
plant_abundance_sensitivity.role: prespecified sensitivity only; directional replication status is defined by the PhenologyP primary analysis

replication_rule.primary: direction_matches_both_endpoints if the pooled out-of-site gain contrast (pollinator minus plant increment) is > 0 and the pooled out-of-site loss contrast (plant minus pollinator increment) is > 0
replication_rule.site_robustness: report the number of 12 held-out sites with the frozen direction for each endpoint; no post-hoc site-count threshold is used to redefine the primary result
replication_rule.no_p_value: leave-one-site-out folds share training data, so fold sign counts are treated as robustness rather than independent hypothesis tests

admission_decision: ADMIT_WITH_FOCAL_EXCLUDED_POLLINATOR_AXIS: plant phenology/flower abundance are tabulated at species x site x year independently of focal dyad identity; published pollinator abundance is not used as the primary pollinator-side exposure because its observation support may overlap with the focal response.

response_validity_gate.consequence: The frozen axis-direction analysis may test predictive structure of recorded annual links, but it cannot be promoted to latent ecological gain/loss replication without new detection-defensible state information.
